sections.text_helper: Section 35.8.21 "TIM multilevel protection register 1 (TIM_MPR1)" in chapter 35 (General purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1445.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x090
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:6 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 5:4 BK2M[1:0]: Break mode for tim_oc2 output
This bit must be modified only when CEN=0 in TIM_CR1.
00: Immediate break
01: Delayed 1 break
10: Delayed 2 break
11: Reserved
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
Bits 3:2 BK1NM[1:0]: Break mode for tim_oc1n output
This bit must be modified only when CEN=0 in TIM_CR1.
00: Immediate break
01: Delayed 1 break
10: Delayed 2 break
11: Reserved
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
Bits 1:0 BK1M[1:0]: Break mode for tim_oc1 output
This bit must be modified only when CEN=0 in TIM_CR1.
00: Immediate break
01: Delayed 1 break
10: Delayed 2 break
11: Reserved
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
